title: My Daily Routine
description: Walk through your typical morning and evening habits in English.
initialGreeting: Hello! I'd love to hear about your daily routine. How does your morning usually start?

title: Hobbies & Free Time
description: Discuss your favorite weekend activities, games, or creative pursuits.
initialGreeting: What do you enjoy doing when you finally get some free time during the week or weekends?

title: Favorite Vacation Spot
description: Describe a memorable trip or a dream destination you want to visit.
initialGreeting: Traveling is always exciting! What's the most memorable trip you've ever taken?

title: Food & Cooking
description: Talk about your favorite cuisines, local dishes, or cooking experiences.
initialGreeting: Let's talk about food! What is your favorite dish or cuisine to eat when eating out?

title: Movies & Entertainment
description: Recommend a movie, TV series, or book you recently enjoyed.
initialGreeting: Have you watched any great movies or shows recently? Tell me what it was about!

title: Fitness & Health
description: Share how you stay active, exercise, or maintain healthy daily habits.
initialGreeting: Staying fit and healthy is key. What kind of exercise or daily activity do you prefer?

title: Technology in Daily Life
description: Discuss the gadget or app you use most often every single day.
initialGreeting: Technology surrounds us everywhere. Which app or gadget can you not live without?

title: Weekend Planning
description: Explain how you organize your upcoming weekend relaxation and tasks.
initialGreeting: The weekend is approaching! What are your plans for Saturday and Sunday?

title: Music & Songs
description: Talk about your favorite artists, genres, or songs that motivate you.
initialGreeting: Music changes our mood instantly! What genres or artists do you listen to most?

title: Hometown & Roots
description: Describe your hometown, its culture, climate, and what makes it special.
initialGreeting: Where did you grow up? Can you describe your hometown and what you love about it?

title: Software Developer Interview
description: Practice answering technical background and project experience questions.
initialGreeting: Welcome to your software developer interview! Can you introduce yourself and your main tech stack?

title: HR Behavioral Interview
description: Use the STAR method to answer tough behavioral workplace questions.
initialGreeting: Tell me about a challenging situation you faced in a project team and how you resolved it.

title: Client Status Update Call
description: Deliver a concise project progress report and outline next major milestones.
initialGreeting: Hi team, thanks for joining our project sync. Can you give us an update on this week's progress?

title: Agile Team Standup
description: Practice stating yesterday's work, today's goals, and any current blockers.
initialGreeting: Good morning! Time for daily standup. What did you work on yesterday and what's on your plate today?

title: Product Demo Presentation
description: Pitch a new feature or application demo pitch to stakeholders.
initialGreeting: Welcome stakeholders! We are excited to present our new feature today. Who wants to begin the demo?

title: Salary & Offer Negotiation
description: Practice confident, professional compensation discussion and terms.
initialGreeting: Thank you for reviewing our offer letter! We'd love to hear your thoughts on the compensation structure.

title: Handling Workplace Conflicts
description: Discuss how you handle conflicting priorities or feedback with colleagues.
initialGreeting: In fast-paced teams, opinions differ. How do you handle constructive disagreement with a teammate?

title: Explaining a Project Delay
description: Articulate root causes, mitigation steps, and revised delivery timelines.
initialGreeting: We noticed the milestone timeline slipped by a week. Can you explain what caused the delay and your fix?

title: IELTS Cue Card: Describe an Influential Leader
description: Practice 2-minute fluent cue card monologue followed by follow-up queries.
initialGreeting: Here is your IELTS Cue Card topic: 'Describe a leader or mentor who influenced you.' Take a moment, then begin!

title: IELTS Cue Card: An Environmental Issue
description: Discuss global environmental challenges, solutions, and personal habits.
initialGreeting: Your cue card topic is: 'Discuss a major environmental challenge in your country and potential solutions.'

title: IELTS Cue Card: A Historical Place
description: Describe a monument or historical site you visited and its significance.
initialGreeting: Your cue card topic: 'Describe a historical monument or site you visited.' Where is it and why is it famous?

title: TOEFL Speaking: Online vs In-Person Education
description: State your preference clearly with supporting rationale and examples.
initialGreeting: Some people prefer online learning, while others prefer traditional classrooms. State your view and explain why.

title: TOEFL Speaking: Remote Work Culture
description: Debate the pros and cons of remote working for young professionals.
initialGreeting: Do you believe working remotely benefits young software professionals more than office work? Explain your choice.

title: Explain My Code
description: Paste code or pick a snippet, then explain your function logic out loud.
initialGreeting: Welcome to the technical simulator! Paste or pick a code snippet, then explain its logic step-by-step out loud.

title: Whiteboard System Design
description: Explain how you would design a scalable URL shortener or Chat service.
initialGreeting: Let's do a system design session! How would you design a scalable URL shortening service like Bitly?

title: Explaining a Complex Bug
description: Describe a difficult bug you debugged, root cause analysis, and the resolution.
initialGreeting: Tell me about the hardest software bug you've encountered recently. How did you diagnose and fix it?

title: REST API Design Best Practices
description: Explain HTTP methods, status codes, authentication, and endpoint structure.
initialGreeting: How do you design a clean, RESTful API? What HTTP methods and status codes do you use?

title: SQL vs NoSQL Databases
description: Compare relational vs document databases for different project use-cases.
initialGreeting: When would you choose a relational SQL database over a NoSQL document store for a new app?
